verdict.rationale: Gemini documents scheduled recurring actions, such as a daily news digest on a daily, weekly, or monthly cadence. These are time-based triggers only. Connected Apps can take actions in other apps, but only when the user asks, and nothing shows user-defined rules that fire on events like an incoming email or a calendar change. Missing for 10: event-based trigger rules (non-time triggers), user-defined conditional rule logic, automatic actions in connected apps without a prompt, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
